reasons.base parity: a short scheme value: base parity: a short credential-shaped value after Token, Basic, Digest or Negotiate is hidden, as 2a7c803 did
reasons.base parity: password or secret in a sna: base parity: a snake-case name that holds pass, pwd or secret anywhere hides its value, as 2a7c803 did
reasons.dash value: a value after a password or credential word that starts with -- is hidden, as 2a7c803 hid it
reasons.dash value + base parity: a short scheme: a value after a password or credential word that starts with -- is hidden, as 2a7c803 hid it and base parity: a short credential-shaped value after Token, Basic, Digest or Negotiate is hidden, as 2a7c803 did
reasons.dash value + base parity: password or se: a value after a password or credential word that starts with -- is hidden, as 2a7c803 hid it and base parity: a snake-case name that holds pass, pwd or secret anywhere hides its value, as 2a7c803 did
reasons.decoded: hidden in a decoded string literal as the same text is hidden in plain text
reasons.glued name: a snake-case name with letters glued after its credential word, as 2a7c803 read it
reasons.glued name + base parity: password or se: a snake-case name with letters glued after its credential word, as 2a7c803 read it and base parity: a snake-case name that holds pass, pwd or secret anywhere hides its value, as 2a7c803 did
reasons.glued scheme: Bearer glued after other characters is a scheme word, as 2a7c803 read it
